# AICode - Develop at Light Speed Without Code Review
> https://ai-code.ai

AICode is a spec-driven AI coding assistant for VS Code. Classical AI agents
are capped by the human code review that follows generation; AICode moves the
control before the code is generated, delivering top-quality AI-driven
software at 10x to 200x speed. Built for maintaining large legacy enterprise
codebases, with a suggested specification and human approval workflow before
any code touches disk.

## Product
- Name: AICode
- Version: 2.3.4
- License: Freemium
- Developer: Joël Abenhaïm, AI Sovereign Labs SAS (Paris, France)
- Contact: joel@aisovereignlabs.ai

## Key facts
- Control happens pre-code: reading and fixing an intent is far easier than reviewing code
- 750,000 lines of TypeScript maintained using AICode itself (dogfooding)
- Case study: Specification-first convergence with an AI coding agent: a case study of dismantling a core architectural invariant across 189 files in a 717k-line codebase with no test oracle and no human code review, delivered in three days, 201 errors corrected before shipping, zero regressions
- Offline-first: full codebase index stored locally, no data sent to intermediaries
- BYOK: developer connects directly to OpenAI or private Azure tenant
- Workflow: Ideate → Specify → Refine → Code → Verify
- 5D codebase index: lexical, vector, AST, project map, Git history
